message: With deletion undecided, what does “recognition” mean when the feathers touch WhWinisker? Could Rohin’s reported C2 example—comparing predictions with an actual calculation, then revising its judgment—help you check that meaning against your prose? Would more thought settle the meaning, or would writing one fresh sentence provide better evidence? Which thinking or writing step do you choose to complete now without waiting for guidance? What observation in the draft would make you change that choice? What finding from this draft, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into your next response?
